payload.claim: `_print_queue` is called after the `with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as scratch:` block has already exited (line 252-265), but every `Candidate.path` and `Refusal.path` it prints (line 278, 282) was produced by `discover_specs` against `exported`, a directory rooted at `Path(scratch) / "at-base"`. That directory is deleted by `TemporaryDirectory.__exit__` before `_print_queue` runs, so the paths an operator sees for every spec and refusal in the printed queue point at a location that no longer exists by the time the command has finished — the printed 'where' is dead on arrival, and no test checks that the printed path is a real, dereferenceable location (only that the spec id substring appears), so this is invisible to the suite.
